file_insights.changes: New migration file created to add database indexes and alter foreign key constraints
key_operations: AlterField operations for StockMovement.material and StockMovement.warehouse to add PROTECT delete behavior
AddIndex operations for 7 database indexes across 4 models
Single-column indexes on is_active, status, count_date, movement_type, and created_at
Composite index on warehouse+movement_type+created_at for StockMovement

file_insights.changes: Added Meta.indexes declarations to 4 models to define database indexes

patterns_discovered.description: Indexes are strategically placed on frequently queried fields: status filters, date ranges, and the most common composite query (warehouse+type+date)
Foreign keys use on_delete=PROTECT to prevent accidental deletion of referenced data, requiring explicit handling
Consistent use of Meta classes with verbose_name, ordering, and now indexes for database optimization
Recognition that StockMovement queries likely filter by warehouse+type+date together, so a composite index is more efficient than individual indexes
is_active flags are indexed in both Warehouse and MaterialStock for efficient active/inactive filtering

gotchas_discovered.description: Migration depends on both inventory.0001_initial and materials.0001_initial, requiring both apps to be initialized first
gotchas_discovered.impact: Could cause migration failures if applied out of order or if materials app isn't installed

gotchas_discovered.description: Django auto-generates index names like 'inventory_i_status_64a2aa_idx' which are hardcoded in migration; regenerating would create new index names
gotchas_discovered.impact: May cause issues if migration is reverted/reapplied; requires careful handling of duplicate indexes

gotchas_discovered.description: Some verbose names use Portuguese ('Armazém') while others use English, mixing localization approaches
gotchas_discovered.impact: Admin interface may display mixed language labels

approach_outcome.methodology: Django best practice - defined indexes in models.Meta, then generated migration file
approach_outcome.execution_quality: High - Strategic index selection based on query patterns
approach_outcome.completeness: Comprehensive - Covered all major models with appropriate indexes

recommendations.recommendation: Monitor query performance before and after applying this migration; composite index on StockMovement may need tuning based on actual query patterns
Consider adding db_index=True directly on model fields that are frequently filtered (like is_active, status) for more explicit optimization hints
Standardize verbose_name localization - either use gettext_lazy() for all Portuguese strings or use English throughout
Document the rationale for the composite index on StockMovement (warehouse, movement_type, created_at) to aid future maintenance
Verify that PROTECT constraint on StockMovement foreign keys doesn't break existing delete workflows; test Material and Warehouse deletion scenarios
